entities.summary: The Hang Jebat Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium with a capacity of 40,000 people in Paya Rumput, Malacca, Malaysia. It was completed in September 2004 and named after a Malacca Sultanate Laksamana, Hang Jebat. The stadium was the home for Melaka United and is currently used mostly for football matches. In 2010, it became the main venue for the Sukma Games.
